hooks.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.filePath // empty"); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && [[ "$FILE" == *.ts || "$FILE" == *.tsx ]]; then npx biome check --write "$FILE" 2>/dev/null; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); FILE=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_input.filePath // empty"); if [ -n "$FILE" ] && echo "$FILE" | grep -qE "\.env"; then echo "{\"systemMessage\": \"WARNING: .env file modified — run git status to verify no secrets are staged for commit\"}"; fi; exit 0'

bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); CMD=$(echo "$INPUT" | jq -r ".tool_input.command"); if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "(rm -rf /|DROP DATABASE|DROP TABLE|git push.*--force.*main|cat .env)"; then echo "BLOCKED: Destructive or sensitive command detected" >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "git clone" && echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "(/tmp|/var/tmp|AppData/Local/Temp)"; then echo "BLOCKED: Clone destination must be inside workspace, not temp directories" >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "docker compose.*down" && ! echo "$CMD" | grep -q "\-\-no-deps"; then echo "WARNING: docker compose down stops ALL services and may cause data loss. Add confirmation or use restart instead." >&2; exit 1; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "docker volume rm"; then echo "BLOCKED: docker volume rm permanently destroys persistent data (Memgraph, Postgres, Qdrant, Redis). Explicit user confirmation required." >&2; exit 2; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "docker system prune"; then echo "WARNING: docker system prune removes all unused images/containers/volumes. Confirm this is intentional." >&2; exit 1; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "wrangler secret delete"; then echo "WARNING: wrangler secret delete will break CF Worker routing for all clients. Confirm this is intentional." >&2; exit 1; fi; if echo "$CMD" | grep -qE "npm unpublish"; then echo "BLOCKED: npm unpublish cannot be undone after 72 hours and breaks existing installs." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0'
